specs.name: current_time
specs.description:
Get the current date and time in a timezone. Use this whenever the answer
depends on today's date or the time of day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, for example America/Toronto or Asia/Kolkata.
timezone.title: Timezone

specs.name: update_plan
specs.description:
Show the user a checklist of the steps you are taking. Use it for tasks
that need three or more steps: call it before starting with the whole plan,
then again with the full updated list whenever a step's status changes.
Keep at most one step in_progress. Skip it for simple questions.

specs.name: web_search
specs.description:
Search the web. Returns titles, URLs and short snippets. Snippets are often
incomplete: use web_fetch on the most relevant URLs before relying on them.

topic.description: Use news for recent events and announcements.
topic.title: Topic

time_range.description: Only return pages published within this period.
time_range.title: Time Range

specs.name: web_fetch
specs.description:
Read a web page and return its main text as Markdown, with links. Use it
to read pages found with web_search or given by the user.

url.description: The full http(s) URL of the page to read.
url.title: Url

specs.name: record_observation
specs.description:
Record what a scheduled watch observed. Only use this when a scheduled
watch run asks you to. Call it once, with found=false if the target or value
could not be found.

input_schema.description: What a watch run saw. ``value`` is set when the extract is a number.
input_schema.title: Observation

specs.name: schedule_create
specs.description:
Propose a scheduled task or watch for the user to confirm.

Use kind=task with a prompt for recurring or one-time work ("every weekday at
8am summarize ..."), and kind=watch with a watch spec to monitor a value and
alert on a condition ("tell me when the fare drops under $1500"). Resolve
relative times ("tomorrow 8am") with current_time first, and give one-shot
times as ISO 8601 with an offset. The job stays inactive until the user
confirms it in the UI; tell the user what you proposed and the next run times
this tool returns.

Changed.description: The value moved by at least ``min_delta`` since the previous observation.
Changed.title: Changed

CronSchedule.description: Standard five-field cron, evaluated in local wall-clock time of ``timezone``.
CronSchedule.title: CronSchedule

IntervalSchedule.description: Every N seconds of elapsed time (daylight saving does not affect it).
IntervalSchedule.title: IntervalSchedule

WatchSpec.description: What to look at, what to extract, and when to raise an alert.

target.description: A URL, or a search query, describing where to look.
target.title: Target

extract.description: What to read from the target, e.g. 'lowest round-trip fare in CAD'.
extract.title: Extract

WatchSpec.title: WatchSpec

input_schema.description: The editable part of a job.

prompt.description: For tasks: what the agent should do.
prompt.title: Prompt

input_schema.title: JobSpec

specs.name: schedule_list
specs.description: List the user's scheduled tasks and watches with their status and next run.

specs.name: schedule_set_status
specs.description: Pause, resume or delete a scheduled job by id (see schedule_list).

status.description: active resumes a paused job; it cannot activate an unconfirmed one.
status.title: Status

specs.name: notify_me
specs.description:
Send the user a message by email and browser push, for example a summary
they asked to receive. It only reaches the user themselves and needs their
approval each time.
